meta.title: Injury & depth-deficiency requirement/gap register
meta.requirement: The system must track injuries and know any deficiencies in defenses (e.g. 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replacing starters) and the same for offenses (starters vs backups).
meta.rule: This register answers what verified official data can and cannot satisfy today. Depth-string cells are blank wherever no official league source publishes them - never inferred. The verified sample below is transcribed from the official Week 10 2026 injury report read on 2026-11-12.

gap_rows.requirement_item: Weekly player injury status per club (injury, practice status, game status)
gap_rows.evidence: Official Week 10 2026 report publishes Player / Position / Injuries / Practice Status / Game Status for all 32 clubs; verified live 2026-11-12.
gap_rows.gap: No gap for status itself; the report is point-in-time and must be stored at publication time
gap_rows.discovery_suggestion: Ingest weekly before kickoff into an append-only store keyed by (week, team, published_at) - SG-13

gap_rows.requirement_item: Depth string (1st/2nd/3rd/4th) for every player, offense and defense
gap_rows.evidence: NFL.com club depth-chart path returns 404 (checked 2026-11-12, VH-SRC-03); the injury report carries no depth column.
gap_rows.gap: No league-published depth ordering exists at any official source tried
gap_rows.discovery_suggestion: Infer role tiers from prior-week usage (snap-share ranks within position group, from official-play-by-play-derived feeds) and cross-check club-published depth charts where clubs publish them (e.g. colts.com, verified by a sibling session). Label every tier 'inferred'; keep official depth cells blank - Q-08, SG-02

gap_rows.requirement_item: Detect when a 2nd/3rd/4th-string player must replace a starter on defense
gap_rows.evidence: Game-status 'Out'/'Doubtful' identifies unavailable players officially; whether the replacement is a backup string is not official.
gap_rows.gap: Replacement identity and string are not published pre-kickoff by the league
gap_rows.discovery_suggestion: Combine (a) official Out/DNP rows with (b) inferred usage tiers and (c) the next player on the club's own depth page where it exists; publish the evidence sentence and the inference label together

gap_rows.requirement_item: Same deficiency detection on offense (starters vs backups)
gap_rows.evidence: Same as IG-03; verified example rows below (NE RB room, WAS interior line) show the official half of the signal.
gap_rows.discovery_suggestion: Same as IG-03; unit (offense/defense) can be assigned from the official Position column, which is published

gap_rows.requirement_item: Point-in-time discipline (report as published before kickoff, never retroactively updated)
gap_rows.evidence: The official report is re-published daily (Wed/Thu/Fri + game day); each version is a legitimate snapshot.
gap_rows.gap: No store exists yet that keeps superseded versions
gap_rows.discovery_suggestion: Append-only store per SG-13; features join on the latest version strictly before kickoff

gap_rows.requirement_item: League injury-report policy text (filing deadlines, definitions)
gap_rows.gap: Policy text cannot be quoted from the cited URL
gap_rows.discovery_suggestion: Locate a serving official copy (news article variant is in the root register) or mark the register entry dead with retrieval dates - SG-07

verified_week10_sample.note: Transcribed exactly from the official Week 10 2026 report (VH-SRC-02, chunk 0, read 2026-11-12). 'String' is blank in every row: the official report does not publish depth ordering. Practice abbreviations: DNP = Did Not Participate, LIM = Limited, FULL = Full Participation.
